scope: Public historical scene research and audio suitability checks. No person tracking, identities, private addresses or investigative leads were produced.
research_limits: Unknown means the cited publication did not establish the filming location. This is not proof that investigators still do not know it.
Missing-person whereabouts and an unidentified filming site are different questions. No missing-person footage was selected.
No video was reconstructed from article text or substituted for an unavailable original.
The separate Sycamore Gap comparison has a publicly known filming site. It is not an unresolved-location case or a successful blind location test.

analysed.case_context: A public disturbance clip published with reporting of a police investigation. The article leaves the filming site unidentified.
analysed.download: First request returned HTTP 403. A normal browser User-Agent and the public player Referer retrieved the embedded file. No authentication was used.

analysed.case_context: A published excerpt of the Sycamore Gap felling footage. The site is publicly known; no site or date was supplied to SoundGeo.
analysed.scope: Known-site negative comparison, separate from unidentified scenes. The published excerpt is shorter than the recording described in court reporting.
analysed.download: The police page and Sky copy returned HTTP 403. The public Times Radio YouTube upload was retrieved with the installed Node runtime. The first successful low-audio-quality copy was preserved but not analysed; the analysis uses the highest available audio quality, with no audio re-encoding.

other_candidates.reason: The linked video is private. No media analysed.
The report quotes a police appeal about an unidentified filming location. The accessible publication provides still images, not the underlying recording. Its radio player is unrelated.
Reporting supplies the town but no exact filming site. A direct page request timed out. The downloader then exited zero with zero media items; this is not a successful acquisition. No media analysed.
Follow-up reporting identifies Ahmedabad. No SoundGeo result claimed.

execution.media_analysis: CPU quota 50%, 1 GiB RAM, no swap, nice 15, idle I/O priority, private network with loopback only
execution.builds_and_required_checks: CPU quota 200%, 8 GiB RAM, 1 GiB swap, nice 10, idle I/O priority, offline; one default Cargo target directory

result: Neither downloaded clip supported a location search. Both full analyses stopped before loading flight references. No location or investigative lead was established.
improvement: Added check-audio: an offline, reference-free intake command with a media hash, decoded duration, default detector settings, individual observations, method-specific reasons and an optional insufficient-evidence exit code. Existing output files are preserved. Detector and location acceptance thresholds are unchanged.
